Welcome to the experiment!

In this experiment, you will be presented with a series of 55 probability reasoning problems.
These probability reasoning problems are all under the same scenario.
Each trial comes with its specific set of information for you to consider.
Your task is to find a solution based on your intuition.

When making a decision, please enter your estimate in percentage (%).
Please rely solely on your intuition and refrain from using calculators.

At the end of the experiment, one of your responses will be selected at random.
Your potential bonus will be determined by the accuracy of this chosen response.
Accuracy is assessed as follows:
If your response is within 3% of the correct answer, you will earn a bonus of £1.
Additionally, if your response is exactly the same as the correct answer, you will receive an extra bonus of £0.5.
Responses that do not meet these criteria will not receive a bonus.

Press Space to continue.
